test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mr. Akai starts from Point A and drives 15 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 18 km, turns right and drives 23 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 26 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/431bda33c0e2e8181eb86d1b7714144c2fbb2798ec3fe73dfc8cc0c7ddb7676f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a38f83070b6d7b66b28116e16bb5ce90116408e4d836b25dccb7d19155355dc.png] 

**
To reach point A again, he should drive 26 - 18 = 8 km in East direction.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
